pr.title: chore(cli): make merge --wait more durable
pr.body: Closes #93 - 🟣 ~~[chore(cli): make merge --wait more durable (#94)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/94)~~ (merged) 👈 - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: After the grace polls with no checks reported, wait_for_checks returns success even when branch protection is gating the merge on required checks that have not registered yet, so merge --wait merges early into a block.
